# io.systemd.Report.Uploader

<!-- Generated by `make docs-reference`. Do not edit. -->

Backend API for uploading reports. This interface shall be implemented by services linked into /run/systemd/report.upload/

## Methods

### Upload

Upload a report now.

```go
func (c *Client) Upload(ctx context.Context, in UploadIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report` | `?object` | Report data as JSON variant. Either this field or reportData (below) have to be specified. This mode is used if signing is not used, and hence a precise binary formatting of the JSON data is not relevant. |
| `reportData` | `?string` | Report data in Base64. Either this field or report (above) have to be specified. This mode is used if signing is enabled, as a precise binary formatting of the JSON data is important to authenticate the signature. This data contains a JSON-SEQ compliant stream of objects, the first being the report, the following ones signature objects. |
